meta.title: Hole Card - 3
meta.description: Bonds and trust; together they allow the opponent's chips to be exchanged for our survival.

units.rawText: Up ahead... That's where Odette and Turing are.
units.displayText: Up ahead... That's where Odette and Turing are.

spans.text: Up ahead... That's where Odette and Turing are.

units.rawText: The Entropic hordes churn and writhe, forming a purplish-black wall in front of Turing and Hannah, blocking off all possibility of advance.
units.displayText: The Entropic hordes churn and writhe, forming a purplish-black wall in front of Turing and Hannah, blocking off all possibility of advance.

spans.text: The Entropic hordes churn and writhe, forming a purplish-black wall in front of Turing and Hannah, blocking off all possibility of advance.

units.rawText: Seems like they put most of their forces here. Looks like we won't be able to force our way through.
units.displayText: Seems like they put most of their forces here. Looks like we won't be able to force our way through.

spans.text: Seems like they put most of their forces here. Looks like we won't be able to force our way through.

units.rawText: Hannah takes a deep breath, then works up her courage before looking up to Sol.
units.displayText: Hannah takes a deep breath, then works up her courage before looking up to Sol.

spans.text: Hannah takes a deep breath, then works up her courage before looking up to Sol.

units.rawText: I have a plan... Can I trouble you to help me out again?
units.displayText: I have a plan... Can I trouble you to help me out again?

spans.text: I have a plan... Can I trouble you to help me out again?

units.rawText: Hannah takes out her communicator and calls Sol's original frequency.
units.displayText: Hannah takes out her communicator and calls Sol's original frequency.

spans.text: Hannah takes out her communicator and calls Sol's original frequency.

units.rawText: Although, I don't know if you're brave enough to let me in to talk.
units.displayText: Although, I don't know if you're brave enough to let me in to talk.

spans.text: Although, I don't know if you're brave enough to let me in to talk.

units.rawText: The Entropic hordes fall silent for a moment, and then they roll aside like the tide.
units.displayText: The Entropic hordes fall silent for a moment, and then they roll aside like the tide.

spans.text: The Entropic hordes fall silent for a moment, and then they roll aside like the tide.

units.rawText: They recede before Hannah's tiny form, opening a clear path for her.
units.displayText: They recede before Hannah's tiny form, opening a clear path for her.

spans.text: They recede before Hannah's tiny form, opening a clear path for her.
